close_reason: Added # Limitations to names_match public rustdoc
description: The public names_match() rustdoc does not mention that TeletexString and BMPString are not normalized — only a private helper (any_to_str_bytes) documents this. A caller reading only the public API will not discover that names_match() may return false for semantically equivalent names using legacy string types. Add to names_match() rustdoc or crate-level # Limitations: 'TeletexString and BMPString are not normalized in v0.1; name matching against these types falls back to raw DER byte comparison. Certificates from legacy PKIs using these types may fail validation.' Ref: RFC 5280 §7.1.
title: names_match: document TeletexString/BMPString limitation in public rustdoc
